Specifically, implementing any predictive model requires ongoing monitoring to address biases and ensure it doesn’t exacerbate existing inequalities. Robust external oversight – involving students and advisors – is crucial, along with a transparent opt-out mechanism and prioritization of preventative support over reactive identification. Only with these safeguards in place would I feel comfortable supporting implementation.

Without these safeguards, I fear the model could inadvertently exacerbate existing inequalities and erode trust.
